why: Holmes says this part of the moor, as the Inspector remarked, is very hard and dry.
Holmes points to a long hollow falling away towards Mapleton that must have been wet on Monday night.

text: Tuesday, early morning: the horse near Mapleton
why: Straker left home at one in the morning, so the struggle came after that, and Holmes reasons the horse then crossed toward Mapleton. The label follows from his stated working hypothesis.
